title: Builder's Utils: <Enhance> [BTW Addon]
description: Adds no-clip, custom reach, flight speed, and more !
body:
# Builder's Utils: <Enhance> (BTW:CE Addon)
## Features
### Command
/enhance <player> <enhancement name> [value]

[] = optional

<> = needed

| = OR
### Enhancements
- noClip = phase through blocks
- insta-break = break blocks instantly
- insta-place = place blocks instantly
- no momentum = disable the glide effect when flying
- replace mode = replace blocks when placing (it places normally when sneaking) 
- extra tooltips = show durability (when F3+H is enabled)
- no update = placing and breaking block doesn't send blocks update
- true night vision = disable the red overlay
- custom reach
- custom flight speed

NoClip can also be set by using the F3+F4 gamemode switch feature
### Works in multiplayer
Needed on both client and server
## Supported languages:
- English
## Dependencies
- [Better Than Wolves CE](https://modrinth.com/mod/btwce)
## Found a bug or have suggestions ?
[Issue tracker](https://github.com/BTW-Community/Builders-Utils-Enhance/issues)
## Download: 
[HERE](https://modrinth.com/mod/builders-utils-enhance/versions)
